changes.text: Keyboard focus shows the solid 2px `--ss-primary` outline. The track used to replace it with a `--ss-primary-soft` glow at about 1.5:1 contrast, which was close to invisible.
The thumb mirrors under `dir="rtl"`: it is positioned with `inset-inline-start` instead of physical `left` and `translateX`, so it slides toward the inline end in both directions.

Plain-HTML behaviour in `dssoca/vanilla.js`: a click on `.ss-switch .track[role="switch"]` or on its sibling `.label` flips `aria-checked` and the `.on` class, and the root emits a bubbling `ss:change` event with `{ checked }`.
`labelHidden` prop: hides the `label` visually and keeps it as the accessible name, for dense settings rows where the visible context sits elsewhere.

New component: an accessible on/off toggle built on a native `<button role="switch">`, with a square track and thumb, bindable `checked`, an optional clickable `label`, and `disabled`, `size`, `name`, `describedby` and `onchange` props.
